input.name: Get Member Account Count
input.description: Logs into the Corevance Core Banking Admin, searches for a member by numeric member ID, and reports the number of accounts held by that member (as shown in the Accounts table on the Member Detail page).

inputs.name: member_id
inputs.description: Numeric member identifier to search for

outputs.name: accounts_table_text
outputs.description: Raw tab-separated text of the member's Accounts table (header + one row per account). Caller can count rows/lines to get the number of accounts, or parse account details.
